cn_addition_service_capacity.title: Electrical service capacity
cn_addition_service_capacity.statement: Existing main-service capacity is verified before any subpanel or HVAC equipment order is placed; a subpanel rides the building permit, a main-service upgrade is its own permit.

cn_addition_permit_lead.title: Permit lead times
cn_addition_permit_lead.statement: Every permit application is filed 2 weeks before job start — except TDEC septic, which is filed 6 weeks before; demo never starts without the building permit in hand.

cn_addition_roof_tiein_photos.title: Roof tie-in photos
cn_addition_roof_tiein_photos.condition: The new roof ties into or over-frames the existing roof
cn_addition_roof_tiein_photos.statement: Existing conditions are photo-documented on day one of roof framing.

cn_addition_septic_trigger.title: TDEC septic trigger
cn_addition_septic_trigger.statement: TDEC septic permitting applies only when the job modifies or installs a septic system — added bedrooms or bathrooms alone do not trigger it; never break ground while TDEC is pending.

cn_addition_weathertight_gate.title: Weathertight gate
cn_addition_weathertight_gate.statement: Interior work begins only once roofing is complete, and insulation/drywall are never scheduled before rough inspections pass.

cn_addition_window_order.title: Window ordering
cn_addition_window_order.statement: Windows and exterior doors are ordered at permit submittal; any non-stock size is verified for real lead time before the schedule assumes stock.

cn_addition_below_grade_package.title: Below-grade package
cn_addition_below_grade_package.condition: Sloped-lot or walkout addition — unless engineering specifies otherwise
cn_addition_below_grade_package.assume: A below-grade package runs between foundation and framing: waterproofing and drainage board on the below-grade wall, foundation drain with filter fabric sloped to daylight, gravel backfill

cn_addition_completion_milestone.title: Completion milestone
cn_addition_completion_milestone.condition: Unless customer scheduling forces a different day
cn_addition_completion_milestone.assume: The job-complete milestone is the PM's personal walkthrough with the customer, one working day after the last item (final inspection, landscaping, exterior finishes, deck) finishes

cn_addition_framing_method.title: Framing method
cn_addition_framing_method.condition: Unless scope explicitly specifies trusses, roof span exceeds ~24 ft, footprint exceeds ~800 sqft, or the PM confirms trusses

cn_addition_schedule_slack.title: Front-loaded schedule pressure
cn_addition_schedule_slack.condition: Unless the PM explicitly directs compressing closeout
cn_addition_schedule_slack.assume: Compression pressure belongs before interior finishes; from interior finishes onward the schedule keeps intentional slack and the back half is not panic-compressed

cn_addition_hvac_type.title: HVAC type
cn_addition_hvac_type.condition: Unless scope says "ducted", "duct work", or "air handler" (duct-extension path applies); if still ambiguous, ask rather than guess
cn_addition_hvac_type.assume: Mini-split — short line-set rough, no separate rough-in phase

cn_addition_lvl_risk.title: LVL-omitted risk
cn_addition_lvl_risk.condition: Structural documents contain "LVL omitted, sized per IRC" language — unless final engineering is already complete
cn_addition_lvl_risk.assume: Carry it as a flagged change-order risk — value-engineered engineered lumber tends to come back as a change order after final engineering

cn_addition_retro_detection.title: Retro-phase detection
cn_addition_retro_detection.condition: Unless the PM explicitly folds it into the addition's new-construction scope
cn_addition_retro_detection.assume: Work belongs in its own Retro-phase item (pre-addition work on the existing home) when any signal fires: area mismatch with the addition objective, "existing" language in scope text, or unresolved spatial location for a new feature

cn_addition_settling_cracks.title: Tie-in settling cracks
cn_addition_settling_cracks.condition: Unless cracking is structural or beyond hairline
cn_addition_settling_cracks.assume: Hairline drywall cracks at new-to-existing tie-ins (above doors, windows, headers) are an expected year-one settling issue handled as a 1-year-warranty return visit, not a scheduled job task

cn_addition_water_heater_day.title: Water heater plumbing delay
cn_addition_water_heater_day.condition: Scope includes a new tank or tankless water heater

rows.label: Added delay
rows.context: Tank is set before rough-in stubs into it; merely extending an existing heater's vent adds nothing

rows.label: non-habitable clear height
rows.context: no habitable-space code paths; access (e.g. exterior barn doors) rides in exterior finishes, not interior

rows.label: non-stock / custom sizes
rows.context: silent lead-time trap — the schedule may assume stock lead for what is actually a custom unit
